name: weekly-threshold-xp
description: WAS with Goal Completion % >= 100% and Threshold XP Ready?=1 awards WEEKLY_THRESHOLD|{enrollment}|{week}|{percent} tiers via 035.
prerequisites: WAS for Schmidt + Week with Goal Completion % >= 1
Mike UI-attest no competing Threshold automation

input_fields.note: Trigger 035 on Weekly Athlete Summary recordId when Threshold XP Ready?=1

prohibited_side_effects: Writing formula Goal Completion % / Threshold XP Ready?
safe_rerun_behavior: Requeue or re-run skips existing tier keys; creates only newly met tiers
cleanup_instructions: Optional delete threshold XP Events; clear Threshold XP Status for retest
manual_requirements: Seed WAS shots to cross 100% (and optionally 125/150)
current_automation_support: 035 (repo rebuild 2026-07-25) + WAS Threshold XP Ready? formula
